rows.title: Affine Exponential-Family Log-Density Ratio

maturity_record.invariant: The supported log-density ratio between two parameters is affine in the sufficient statistic with the exact log-partition difference.
maturity_record.assumption_review: Finiteness, nonemptiness, and strict base-weight support make every logarithm ordinary and finite. The result is scalar and does not assert an extended-real identity at zero support.

qualified_declaration_statements.fep143_logDensityRatio_eq:
theorem fep143_logDensityRatio_eq
    (family : ScalarExponentialFamily Outcome)
    (left right : ℝ) (outcome : Outcome) :
    Real.log
        (family.law left outcome / family.law right outcome) =
      (left - right) * family.statistic outcome -
        (family.logPartition left - family.logPartition right)

rows.statement_review: For the same positive-base family, log(p_left/p_right)=(left-right)*statistic-(A(left)-A(right)); the base cancels exactly.
rows.assumptions_and_scope: Both laws use the same base and statistic. Different families need not satisfy this ratio formula. Strict support makes logs finite and ordinary; no singular-density or extended-log convention is used.

rows.adverse_witness_specification_unexecuted: Changing base between the two laws introduces an additional log base ratio; equal parameters or constant statistic make the ratio trivial.
rows.nearest_topic_distinction: 026 ordinary positive log quotient is a neighbor;058 Gibbs identity is broader finite certificate.143 derives its affine ratio from the explicit parametric family.
